::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 11th [1892-1893?][^1]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/25
:::

Dear Madam
If my [coadjutors](people/person_229.qmd) can make room your paper shall go [in](organizations/other_52.qmd) but there is a sad crowd of appeals

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: ‘Coadjutors’ presumably means [A.D. Innes](people/person_744.qmd) and [Christabel Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd), and suggests the letter dates from about 1893.
